topic: Troubleshooting low sensor traffic and connectivity
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on diagnosing anomalous or unusually low traffic reported by multiple sensors across different facilities (PMG_ZA_Nyanga_Junction_Mall and PMG_ZA_Bara_Mall). 

**Key Issues Identified:**
*   Multiple sensors were experiencing very low traffic, even after attempted reboots.
*   The issue was suspected to be related to electrical problems or sensor malfunction.
*   Specific troubleshooting steps included reviewing MAC addresses and facility numbers for diagnosis.

**Technical Discussion Points:**
*   There was a discussion regarding firmware updates; it was clarified that only an update had been performed, not a full re-flashing/re-imaging of the sensors.
*   A previous plan involving clearing sessions and running modeling on specific sensor IDs (19906 and 24996) was outlined.
decisions: Investigate low traffic levels for PMG_ZA_Bara_Mall_Entrance_2 (facility 27831) and other listed sensors.
Client will attempt to change the data provider/card for the Bara Mall sensor.
action_items: Review MAC addresses and connectivity status of specified sensors.
Follow up on running modeling and clearing sessions for IDs 19906 and 24996.
